dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Two distinct 'O' shaped rings in the superior-central region exhibit sharp, high-contrast dark perimeters transitioning abruptly to light-tan interiors. A larger, complex 'C' shaped structure is visible in the mid-lateral section with a more diffused gradient transition on its posterior edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters. A high concentration of solid dark pixels is localized near the anterior flipper insertion point, showing no internal gradient or lighter core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the two superior 'O' rings form a horizontal vector. Connecting these to the centroid of the prominent 'C' structure below creates an obtuse triangle with the longest side extending towards the posterior region.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of five distinct, high-contrast keratinous claws on the distal end of the anterior flipper, appearing as sharp, low-intensity vertical bands against the lighter fur of the flipper.
